page_title: NOT 1-1 NEW | Nottingham Forest v Newcastle 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Bruno Guimaraes and he is replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
90+5' Morato (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
90+4' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+3' Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
90+1' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
90+1' James McAtee (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) commits a rough foul. Paul Tierney stops the game and makes a call.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by James McAtee sets up Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
85' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
84' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham) replaces Igor Jesus.
83' Today's match ends for Luca Netz who will be replaced by James McAtee (Nottingham).
82' The attendance for today's match is 30691.
81' Chris Wood (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
80' A pass travels right across the box to Igor Jesus (Nottingham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Nick Pope denies him with a decent save.
80' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
77' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' It looks like Igor Jesus (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Paul Tierney won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
74' 0 - 1 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
73' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chris Wood (Nottingham) replacing Taiwo Awoniyi.
73' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
73' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. William Osula is replaced by Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
69' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.

67' A rebound falls to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Matz Sels anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.

67' This should have been a goal! William Osula (Newcastle Utd) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
66' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) makes a slide tackle, but referee Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) for Dilane Bakwa.

62' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
61' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Nick Woltemade will be replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd).
61' Here is a change. Jacob Murphy is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
60' Good movement by Neco Williams (Nottingham), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
59' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' What a wasted opportunity by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Nick Pope makes a decent save to thwart him.
55' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
54' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
54' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Paul Tierney who sees an offensive foul.
52' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
51' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) strikes a thunderbolt from a long-range free kick, but the effort goes well wide of the left post. It's going to be a goal kick.
50' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Igor Jesus (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
47' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the right post.
46' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
46' Vitor Pereira has made a change at the break. Ryan Yates has come on in place of Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

43' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Matz Sels guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
41' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Luca Netz (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
38' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

36' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Paul Tierney with no other option than to blow for a foul.
35' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Cunha (Nottingham) squanders a huge chance from point blank range. His volley is directed towards the right side of the goal, but Nick Pope is alert and makes an amazing save!
33' Rough tackle by Morato (Nottingham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
27' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
26' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
24' Matz Sels (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' The game is interrupted now, Matz Sels (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
20' Dangerous play by Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

18' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
17' Neco Williams (Nottingham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
17' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) inside the box. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
16' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paul Tierney has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' The ball possession at the moment is 28:72.
12' The ball is cleared after William Osula (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' A cross into the box picks out William Osula (Newcastle Utd), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
9' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) but poses no threat.
3' Paul Tierney blows for a foul after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Paul Tierney.
